parts:
Luo,

there's a couple of things that you need to take care of, before your chart will work.
First, you'll have to work on the YearQuarter variable - split it in pieces along the white space (look into strsplit) to get Year and Month out.
Then pieve them together into a proper date (look into the package lubridate)
In your line chart you need to set a different grouping variable. You seem to be grouping by YearQuarter at the moment, hence the vertical lines. Instead, identify what the lines have in common across time (is it Provider or Type or both?). Use the grouping variable for that, and you should be getting closer to what you want to show,

HTH,

Heike

mydf <- data.frame(
        provider = rep(letters[1:4], 20),
        quart = seq(from = as.Date("2011-09-01"), to = as.Date("2011-09-30"), length.out = 20),
        customers = runif(20) * 200)
head(mydf)

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mydf, aes(x = quart, y = customers)) + geom_line() + facet_wrap(~ provider)


Cheers,
Roman
